issues.problem: The storage cabinets and equipment tables along the east wall obstruct the low-sill windows. The equipment on the tables further obstructs access to and use of the windows.
issues.fix: Relocate these furniture-and-equipment groups to solid wall sections, keeping the windows accessible and their lower portions clear.

issues.problem: The task chairs face their desks correctly but sit too far away for seated work: roughly 0.7–0.8 m separates the chair fronts from the desk edges.
issues.fix: Move the chairs closer to their respective desk edges so users can reach the work surfaces and keyboards comfortably, while retaining room to pull the chairs out.

issues.problem: The stools north and south of the meeting tables are separated from the table edges by roughly 0.6–0.8 m, leaving seated users too far away to use the surfaces comfortably.
issues.fix: Bring these stools closer to their respective tables, with their seats positioned for comfortable reach and adequate knee space. Keep obj_0046 between obj_0028 and obj_0018.
